name: 1Password
description: Read and manage items and secrets in the vaults you authorize.

methods.label: Connect 1Password
methods.whenToUse: Use a service account scoped to the vaults your agents need.

credentialFields.label: Paste your 1Password Service Account token
credentialFields.helperMd: Create a service account with access only to the required vaults. Grant Read Items and Write Items for reading and managing items. Service-account vault access and permissions are fixed at creation; create a new token and reconnect to change them. Read-only tokens can connect, but writes will be denied by 1Password.

methods.guidanceMd: [Create a 1Password service account](https://www.1password.dev/service-accounts/get-started#create-a-service-account), choose its vaults and permissions, then paste its token below.
warnings: Authorized agents can read secret values and change or delete items in the selected vaults. Grant access only to trusted agents.
